builds.title: Moth Ledger, Terran Dreamlands Cat Monk 1
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 14, or 19 when only smell matters.
builds.languages: Speaks Cat and understands and reads Common. A companion who spends a week with her can understand her Cat.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +1 and Dexterity save +5. Monk AC 15 is 10 + 3 Dexterity + 2 Wisdom. HP 9 is 8 + 1 Constitution.
Monk grants Acrobatics and Insight. Soldier grants Athletics and Intimidation. Terran grants Perception and Stealth and uses Dexterity with Athletics.

Keen Smell gives advantage on smell-based Perception. Land on Your Feet can reduce falling damage as a reaction. For falls shorter than 60 ft., subtract 1d6. For falls of 60 ft. or more, take 1d6 total. If damaged, a DC 10 Dexterity save lets her land upright.
Nine Lives. If killed, she can return after 1d3 days of rest in the Dreamlands. Eight lifetime uses. She still has all eight.
Dreamlands Travel requires a hidden, available Gate of Slumber and an unobserved crossing. The GM places gates and decides which are open.
actions: Claws. Unarmed strike +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit for 2 + 3 slashing damage.
Bite. Unarmed strike +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit for 1 + 3 piercing damage.
Martial Arts. After her Attack action uses an unarmed strike, she can make another as a bonus action at +5 to hit for 1d4 + 3 bludgeoning.
Moon Jump. In the Dreamlands, use an action to travel between planet and moon in 2d6 minutes. Provokes opportunity attacks. Two uses per long rest.
builds.tactics: Moth claws and bats at an ankle until her ally can reach the door. If it shuts before she gets through, she looks for a beam above the attacker.

builds.title: Veller Dross, Mythos Ghoul Wizard 1
builds.languages: Common and Ghoul. Dwarvish and Undercommon from Sage.
traits: Proficiency +2. Intelligence save +5 and Wisdom save +3. Base AC 12 is 10 + 2 Dexterity. Mage Armor raises it to 15. HP 8 is 6 + 2 Constitution.
Wizard grants Insight and Investigation. Sage grants Arcana and History. Scrounger gives advantage on Perception or Investigation checks to locate buried or hidden objects.
Grave Nose gives advantage on smell-based Perception for corpses, carrion, meat, and undead. Immune to nonmagical diseases. Advantage on saves against magical diseases.
Can burrow in sand, earth, mud, or ice. Leave a tunnel if the material is solid enough. While leaving no tunnel, he must hold his breath.
Psychic Feast. One minute with an eligible corpse grants a skill or tool insight. Add +1 if untrained or +3 instead of +2 if trained. Veller starts with no insights and can hold at most three.
Spellcasting uses Intelligence, DC 13 and +5 spell attack. Two 1st-level slots and a component pouch. Arcane Recovery restores one expended 1st-level slot after a short rest once per day.
actions: Fire Bolt. Cantrip, +5 to hit at 120 ft. Hit for 1d10 fire. Other cantrips are Mage Hand and Minor Illusion.
Bite or claws. Unarmed strike +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit for 1d4 + 2 piercing.

Prepared spells. Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Shield, and Thunderwave. Magic Missile has three darts for 1d4 + 1 force each. Shield is a reaction for +5 AC through the start of his next turn, including against the triggering attack, and blocks Magic Missile. Thunderwave fills a 15-ft. cube with DC 13 Constitution saves, 2d8 thunder and 10-ft. push on failure or half damage on success.
Spellbook also contains Detect Magic and Comprehend Languages, which can be cast as rituals without preparing them.
builds.tactics: Veller casts Mage Armor before entering a risky crypt. He uses Thunderwave when pressed at the door and leaves the instant the ledger is safe.

builds.title: Seln Brineglass, Blue Gnorri Fighter 1
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft. or 120 ft. underwater. Passive Perception 14.
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength and Constitution saves both +4. AC 12 is 10 + 2 Dexterity, unarmored. HP 12 is 10 + 2 Constitution.
Sailor grants Athletics, Perception, navigator’s tools and water vehicles. Fighter grants Intimidation and Survival. Gnorri Science grants Medicine and herbalism kit.
Amphibious and unaffected by water pressure. Uses Medium weapons. Moves through 5-ft.-wide spaces normally and squeezes through passages as narrow as 2 ft.
Two arms grant +1 to Strength-based weapon damage. Once per day Seln can spend 10 minutes concentrating to reallocate. Three arms give up the +1. Four also impose −1 to Constitution saves.
Squeeze Entrails. When a critical hit lands, Seln can react to make it a normal hit. Recharge on a short or long rest.
actions: Spear. Strength-based attack +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Two-handed strike deals 1d8 + 3 piercing. Great Weapon Fighting rerolls a 1 or 2 once on its weapon die when used to make a two-handed melee attack. One-handed melee or thrown at 20/60 ft. deals 1d6 + 3 piercing.
Second Wind. Bonus action to heal 1d10 + 1 HP, once per short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Seln wields the spear in both hands and tries to keep the fight within a short dive of deep water. If pressed, Seln uses Second Wind and signals the ferry crew to pull away.

builds.title: Latch Quickroot, Zoog Rogue 2
builds.speed: 25 ft. walking and climbing with three free hands, 15 ft. with two, 10 ft. burrowing
builds.languages: Common and spoken Zoog. Thieves’ Cant from Rogue.
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5 and Intelligence save +4. AC 13 is 10 + 3 Dexterity. HP 15 is 9 at 1st level and 6 at 2nd.

Rogue grants Acrobatics, Insight, Investigation, Sleight of Hand and thieves’ tools. Criminal grants Deception and Stealth. Expertise applies to Stealth and thieves’ tools. Perception comes from Zoog.

Trap Culture grants tool proficiency when building or disarming traps and proficiency on saves against traps. For a save against a trap, add proficiency once to the relevant ability modifier. Dexterity and Intelligence saves already include it.

Facial tentacles and tail can move items between paws without an action. Use either as a bonus action to retrieve a small item from either pouch. Hold your breath when burrowing without leaving a tunnel.
actions: Dagger. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or thrown 20/60 ft. Hit for 1d4 + 3 piercing. Sneak Attack adds 1d6 once per turn with advantage, or if a non-incapacitated enemy of the target is within 5 ft. of it and Latch has no disadvantage. Apply Sneak Attack to the dagger.
Bite. Unarmed strike +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit for 1d4 + 3 piercing.
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Latch uses a dagger if cornered, then puts it in a pouch or transfers it to the tail for movement before finding a place to hide.

concepts.name: Moth Ledger
concepts.motive: Get the new caretaker to leave the upstairs window open.
concepts.hook: Every night Moth drops a little braid of rushes at the front door. One rush in every braid has been dipped in lamp oil.

concepts.name: Veller Dross
concepts.motive: Recover a list of unmarked burials before the crypt is bricked up.
concepts.hook: The burial registry gives the same grave depth for every person on one page. Veller thinks the missing clerk was signaling something.

concepts.name: Seln Brineglass
concepts.motive: Find the diver who moved a channel marker before the night crossing.
concepts.hook: Seln brought back a mooring stone with the same notch as the missing channel marker. A second matching stone still sits on the far side of the channel.

concepts.name: Latch Quickroot
concepts.motive: Find out who rebuilt an old mechanism using Latch’s workshop mark.
concepts.hook: Latch will remove the spring from the cellar lock for free if the party brings back the tiny brass wedge holding it open.
